About the M4A1-S | Guardian

With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted using a jungle tiger hydrographic. The M4A1-S | Guardian is a Classified-grade skin in Counter-Strike 2, featuring the Guardian finish on the M4A1-S. With a Classified rarity classification, it has approximately a ~0.64% chance of dropping from case openings.

How to Obtain: The M4A1-S | Guardian can be unboxed from the Winter Offensive Weapon Case. It belongs to the Winter Offensive Collection.

Float Value and Wear: This skin has a float value range of 0.00 to 0.50. This restricted float range means not all wear conditions are available, which can affect rarity and pricing for specific exteriors. Lower float values within each condition tier produce a cleaner in-game appearance and typically command higher prices.

Price and Market Trends: The M4A1-S | Guardian (Factory New) has a median market price of approximately $118.00, with the lowest listing prices available in the marketplace comparison below. The price has remained stable with minimal movement over the past 7 and 30 days, indicating balanced supply and demand. Across wear conditions, prices range from $31.15 (Field-Tested) to $118.00 (Factory New).

Community Rating: The M4A1-S | Guardian has a community rating of 3.9 out of 5 based on 285 votes. This above-average rating suggests the community considers it a solid choice among M4A1-S skins.

Frequently Asked Questions

What's the difference between Factory New and Minimal Wear for the M4A1-S | Guardian?

Factory New (FN) M4A1-S | Guardian skins have float values between 0.00-0.07, showing minimal to no visible wear. Minimal Wear (MW) floats range from 0.07-0.15, with slight scratches or fading. The price gap between FN and MW varies by finish — some designs like the Guardian pattern hide wear better than others, making MW versions a strong value alternative.

Is the M4A1-S | Guardian worth the price?

The M4A1-S | Guardian sits in the mid-to-high price bracket. It features a distinctive Guardian design that stands out in-game and maintains good trading liquidity. It's part of the The Winter Offensive Collection, obtainable from the Winter Offensive Weapon Case, which adds to its collectible appeal. For players who main the M4A1-S, this skin offers an excellent balance of visual appeal and investment stability compared to budget alternatives.

What is the float value range for the M4A1-S | Guardian?

Float values in CS2 determine a skin's wear level on a scale from 0.00 (perfect) to 1.00 (maximum wear). With a float range of 0.00 to 0.50, this skin has specific wear availability that affects pricing. Lower float values within any condition category (e.g., 0.01 vs 0.06 in Factory New) result in cleaner appearances and typically command higher prices. For high-value trades, always verify the exact float value using inspection tools.

Where is the cheapest place to buy the M4A1-S | Guardian?

Prices for the M4A1-S | Guardian vary across marketplaces due to fees, regional pricing, and seller competition. This skin can be obtained by opening the Winter Offensive Weapon Case or purchased directly from third-party marketplaces. The Steam Community Market charges 15% fees, while third-party markets like Skinport, DMarket, and Buff163 offer lower prices with 2-10% fees. Compare real-time prices in the market comparison table above to find the best deal.

Can I use the M4A1-S | Guardian in competitive CS2?

Yes, all weapon skins including the M4A1-S | Guardian are purely cosmetic and can be used in all CS2 game modes including competitive matchmaking, Premier, and professional tournaments. Skins provide no gameplay advantages or disadvantages - they only change the weapon's visual appearance. Many professional players use skins during official matches, and you'll often see high-value items like this featured in tournament broadcasts.

Is the M4A1-S | Guardian price going up or down?

The M4A1-S | Guardian has remained relatively stable in price recently, with less than 5% movement over the past 7 and 30 days. Stable pricing suggests balanced supply and demand. This can be a good sign for investors looking for low-volatility items, and for buyers it means you're unlikely to overpay. Check the price chart above for longer-term trends.

What collection is the M4A1-S | Guardian from?

The M4A1-S | Guardian is part of the The Winter Offensive Collection. It can be obtained by opening the Winter Offensive Weapon Case. All skins from the same collection share a rarity hierarchy, which affects trade-up contract possibilities and overall value.

What is the story behind the M4A1-S | Guardian?

The in-game description reads: "With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been painted using a jungle tiger hydrographic." The Guardian finish on the M4A1-S is a distinctive design that has made this skin a recognizable part of CS2's visual identity.

Do professional CS2 players use the M4A1-S | Guardian?

Yes, 1 professional CS2 players currently have the M4A1-S | Guardian in their inventory. Pro player adoption is a strong indicator of a skin's prestige and desirability in the community, and can positively influence its market value.
